sources: Patch 1.12 formulas: Warrior/Paladin/Shaman/Druid-cat 1 Str = 2 AP; Rogue 1 Agi = 1 AP and 1 Str = 1 AP; Hunter 1 Agi = 2 ranged AP; ~20 Agi = 1% melee crit (Rogue ~29, Hunter ~53); 1% crit ~ 20-30 AP; 1% hit ~ 15-20 AP up to the hit cap.
Bear Form: armor from items x ~4.5 (Dire Bear + Thick Hide), no parry or block.
Tuned for threat and survival: pre-raid bear lists mix Stamina/armor with Strength, AP, hit and crit for threat.
